newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher, boosted by firm Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher, boosted by firm Wall Street.

text.p: UK shares opened mostly higher on Monday, taking heart from the Dow's continued record-breaking exploits and an absence of any major data which could upset a positive mood among investors.
Dealers said shortages of stock were continuing to drive the market higher and another record peak looked well within reach.
"It would be no surprise to see another record today," one trader said. "There is plenty of cash coming into the market and that should keep driving it on today."
By 0840 GMT the FTSE 100 index was 9.5 points higher at 4,217.2, close to Friday's intraday record of 4,218.4.
